summary.text: Mark Pulido is the Democratic candidate for California State Assembly District 67 in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces Republican Paulo Morales.
His campaign website describes a 54-year residence in Cerritos and a record as an elected official.

paragraphs.text: Mark Pulido lives in Cerritos with his wife, Gloria, and the couple's two children attended local schools, according to his campaign website.
The site says he was a student leader at UCLA and, as an elected official, worked on school improvements, neighborhood safety, infrastructure, housing and local jobs.
It credits his work with a 35 percent reduction in residential burglaries and street, sidewalk and park improvements in Cerritos.
Pulido advanced from the June 2, 2026 primary.
His website lists better schools, safer communities, more affordable housing and policies that reduce the economic burden on working families as his priorities.
